svg.title: Keep the original separate
svg.desc: Identify and keep the original, create a separate working copy with a clear name, and confirm that copy is the file you open. Export to a new file and listen to the result before removing anything. A second file on the same device is not an independent backup.

text.font-family: Pretendard, SUIT, Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
Pretendard, SUIT, Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
text.tspan: Identify → copy → edit → check · audio working copy
